data.body:
Re-brainstorm enrichment (2026-05-23): Confluence and GitHub sub-agents identified Nava-internal sources not in original spec. Changes applied:

SC1: Added gov-benefit-flows to domain vocabulary; internal-nava to license vocabulary.

SC4: Expanded corpus to include (b) navapbc Apache 2.0 GitHub sources — wic-participant-recertification-portal docs/ (~23–37 entries) and template-application-nextjs ADRs (~5–8 entries); (c) Nava Confluence paraphrase sources — PL Pattern Library (~48–68 entries, gov-benefit-flows domain), PM3 SNAP policy hub (~20–30), AAN accessibility checklist (~25–35), DOH trauma-informed design (~12–15), NUI UI lessons learned (~15–20), NL agentic design patterns (~10–12).

SC7: Expanded docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml schema — type enum now includes github-repo-private, confluence-page, confluence-space, google-doc; added access (public|internal-nava) and credentials_required (bool) fields. navapbc/benefits-delivery-system registered as github-repo-private, credentials_required: true, pending provisioned access.

Scenario analysis: added two new scenarios (Confluence inaccessible in CI — mitigated by paraphrase-only approach; BDS inaccessible — mitigated by credentials_required flag).
